productFantasy: You are a bare-knuckle pit fighter trading brutal, readable blows in a torchlit arena, and every landed hit feels like it costs the other body something.

productShell.persistenceContract: Match state is session-only by design; the only persisted value is the settings block (master volume, screenshake scale) in user://pitfight.cfg. A missing or unparsable file is replaced with defaults at boot and never blocks play.
productShell.loadingFallback: All assets are local res:// files loaded synchronously at scene instantiation; there is no network path. If a sprite frame fails to load the fighter falls back to its idle frame and the match continues.
productShell.missingMediaFallback: Missing audio stream = silent hit, gameplay unaffected. Missing sprite clip = hold last valid frame. Missing arena decor = flat void background. Never a crash, never a blocked round.

assetIo.backoffPolicy: single immediate retry then fallback frame; no exponential backoff needed for local-only res:// loads
